content.mission: Oversee and coordinate the management of casualties at the incident site and at public hospitals and polyclinics under the national inter-agency response plan for mass casualty incidents.

sequence.label: Field medical teams
sequence.action: Deploy command and field medical teams to the incident site.

sequence.label: Hospital capacity
sequence.action: Manage resources and capacity at healthcare institutions to attend to casualties.

sequence.label: Ambulance diversion
sequence.action: When an emergency department faces a spike from a major incident, activate ambulance diversion to other hospitals.

hand_offs.when: Casualty management at the site is coordinated with the Incident Manager.
